justification.reason: Explicit K1 cohort expansion from limited-v1 (2 papers,15 annotated figures/tables) to limited-v2 (3 papers,23 annotated figures/tables). Scoring and detector code are unchanged; the complete old per-paper observation records reproduce byte-for-byte under canonical JSON. The additional availability-selected paper exposes one false positive and seven zero-IoU objects. This records the new cohort baseline without changing objective targets; prior v1 truth and measurements remain immutable, and broad coverage stays open under97.

Explicit fixed K1 cohort expansion from v3 (4 papers,29 annotated figures/tables) to v4 (9 papers,50 figures/tables). All four prior complete truth/outcome/prediction records and native/graphics commitments are exact under the already merged detector4. Detector/native code, matching rules and IoU arithmetic are unchanged; only v4 truth selection uses the existing region interpretation. The five predeclared papers expose six missed captions, four false positives and seven new zero IoUs; all50 values remain counted. This proposes recording the larger-cohort baseline with a permanent adjustment history, not removing the failed unadjusted check or changing targets. O1=.8979591836734694 remains below its unchanged .90 objective; O2=.8826424973982893 exceeds its unchanged .75 target. All old releases/results remain immutable; scoped detector recovery and issue97/500-paper coverage remain open. No hard gate is waived.
